claim: The 2019 Kandy development plan reported city land values ranging from roughly LKR 0.5 million to LKR 6 million per perch.

metric.denominator: one perch of land within the Kandy city planning context
metric.source_definition: planning-era land-value range; not a current transaction-price index

bounded_by: Valuation method and micro-location are not specified; this supports land scarcity/cost as a constraint, not a precise current market price.
notes: Use only as bounded planning evidence.
